overview: Texas therapy demand sprawls: Dallas and Houston each contain dozens of distinct submarkets, and clients routinely search across metro boundaries. Clear service-area and telehealth language matters as much as the specialty pages themselves.
We serve both metros remotely, with content written for how people search in each city rather than one template renamed.

city_blurbs.dallas: Fast-growing northern suburbs and a client base that compares practices across the metroplex.
city_blurbs.houston: A large, car-dependent market where service radius and online availability decide who gets called.
